verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes an OpenAPI-documented API (posthog-probe-3) and docs mention building/sharing insights and dashboards and setting alerts (posthog-docs-3, posthog-docs-25), plus MCP/CLI tooling that can run queries and manage flags programmatically (posthog-docs-19, posthog-docs-20, posthog-probe-4, posthog-probe-5), implying dashboard/insight management is API-accessible. However, no evidence pack item explicitly documents dashboard/insight CRUD API endpoints or gives a concrete code example of creating a dashboard or saved insight via API. missing for 10: explicit API/endpoint documentation or examples for creating/updating dashboards and insights programmatically, independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
